title: Flow Library browses the community registry - a user discovers third-party Flows in the app, never on a website
description: Today the app has NO discovery of third-party Flows. listFlows() returns FLOWS only, and a grep across js, routes, services and scripts for cubric-flows-registry returns zero hits - nothing in the app knows the registry exists. A user can only install a Flow they already found and downloaded themselves. At 2.0 that is a contradiction: submissions open to the public and Flows become the headline feature, yet nobody can find a third-party Flow without leaving the app. Fabio 2026-09-20: they must show in the UI, in the Add-on Flows section at the bottom of the Flow Library; a website listing is not an answer because most users never visit the website. This card makes the Add-on Flows section list what is NOT installed yet, read from the registry. Needs a generated index.json in the registry repo first - today flows slash star dot json has no index, so a reader would need one request per Flow. Its sibling MPI-831 builds the same section for INSTALLED packages and the two paid tiles, and ships independently of this card. Umbrella: MPI-560 phase 8. Full plan in plan.md.
